note: Shared road corridor + approach candidates for the Hveragerði–Selfoss–Hella–Hvolsvöllur–Vík stretch, for docs/ai/tasks/ticket-500/south/approved-prompt-v1.md. Reused verbatim (order/entry/exit/gap/role) from the retained cw_long chain in docs/ai/tasks/ticket-493-place-network/samples/chain-walks-v4.json, steps 2135..23041 (25 pieces) — no new geometry acquisition, no new routing engine. `native_start`/`native_end` on each piece below are the chain-walk's own traversal entry/exit points (west-to-east order), copied verbatim from chain-walks-v4.json — NOT each piece's intrinsic stored native START/END field (which is flipped here, since every piece's own stored_direction is 'rev'). The approach_candidates section below uses the separate `stored_field` label ('START'/'END') when citing each piece's intrinsic native convention, matching how other retained files (e.g. place-access-status-v3.csv) cite the same pieces. Candidate coordinates are APPROACH_CANDIDATE (proposed, not owner-selected) except Vík, which has only a single retained candidate and is also still OWNER_SELECTION_PENDING. Driving access/direction is EXACT_GAP for every piece here — the retained WFS layer (faerdferlar2017_1) has no field encoding legal direction/one-way access; the digital stored direction of each piece ('direction': 'rev' below, i.e. stored westbound) is geometry only, never a traffic-direction proof.
